result: QA completed for approval-only scheduled update status. Backend tests pass and the existing Compose service is running healthy. The scheduled worker persists update status via VersionService and the dashboard explicitly states automatic updates are disabled; applying remains an explicit user action. Frontend build could not be executed in this read-only environment because Bun reported EPERM/no package discovery and node_modules is absent; this appears environmental, not a source defect.

evidence.outcome: Hourly update check invokes CheckForUpdateAsync and persists last_update_check.
CheckForUpdateAsync stores UpdateStatus with AvailableVersion; no automatic Apply call exists.
UI displays pending update and says automatic updates are disabled; Apply is an explicit button.

evidence.ref: docker compose ps / docker inspect factorio-manager
evidence.outcome: Existing container is Up and healthy; no container was started or stopped.
Could not run: Bun reported script/package discovery EPERM in the sandbox; no node_modules directory exists.

next_slice.summary: No source fix required from this QA slice; parent may proceed with the healthy implementation. Re-run frontend build in an environment with Bun directory access and installed dependencies.

knowledge_proposal: The update workflow is approval-only: maintenance detects and stores status, while Apply remains explicit. Frontend build verification requires Bun dependency setup and directory permissions.
blockers: Frontend TypeScript/build not independently verified because Bun failed with EPERM/no package discovery and dependencies are not installed in this environment.
